title: Configure CORS with specific allowed origins
description: CORS middleware in index.ts uses cors() with no configuration, allowing all origins. Configure specific allowed origins, methods, and credentials policy to prevent CSRF attacks.
close_reason: Configured CORS with specific allowed origins via env var

title: Set reasonable payload size limits per endpoint
description: Express middleware accepts up to 10GB payloads (index.ts lines 21-22). This is a DoS vulnerability. Set reasonable limits (e.g., 500MB-1GB max) and validate file sizes on specific routes.
close_reason: Set reasonable payload limits: 1mb default, 500mb for files

title: Encrypt saved connection credentials at rest
description: Saved connections in savedConnections.json store passwords in plaintext. Implement encryption using Node crypto for sensitive fields (passwords, tokens). High security priority.
close_reason: Added AES-256-GCM encryption for credentials at rest

title: Establish unit test suite with Jest/Vitest
description: Currently only basic smoke test exists. Need unit tests for core services: exportService, importService, syncService, jobManager. Target 70%+ coverage for critical paths.

title: Add ESLint and Prettier with pre-commit hooks
description: No linting configuration exists. Code style inconsistencies across codebase make reviews harder. Add ESLint, Prettier, and husky pre-commit hooks for consistent code style.

title: Add frontend error boundaries and loading states
description: App.svelte has no error boundary for API failures. Missing loading spinners and button disable states during operations. Add Svelte error handling and UX improvements.

title: Use streaming/worker threads for large ZIP compression
description: compressDirectory in exportService.ts compresses synchronously in main thread. Blocks other requests during large file compression. Use streaming compression or worker threads.

title: Add rate limiting middleware
description: No rate limiting on API endpoints. Vulnerable to brute force or DoS attacks. Add express-rate-limit middleware with appropriate limits per endpoint type.
close_reason: Added express-rate-limit middleware for all API routes

title: Add exponential backoff retry for network operations
description: dispatcharrClient.ts has 120s timeout but no retry logic for transient failures. Implement exponential backoff retry strategy to handle temporary network issues gracefully.

title: Add environment variable validation at startup
description: No validation that required environment variables (DATA_DIR, PORT) are set in index.ts. Vague errors if misconfigured. Validate environment at startup with clear error messages.

title: Add request correlation IDs for distributed tracing
description: No correlation IDs or request tracing across async operations. Hard to follow a request through background jobs. Implement request correlation IDs for better observability.

title: Add E2E tests with Playwright for key workflows
description: No end-to-end tests covering real workflow scenarios. Add Playwright tests covering backup→restore→sync workflows to catch regressions in complex operations.

title: Replace any types with proper error type definitions
description: 17+ instances of catch (error: any) throughout dispatcharrClient.ts, exportService.ts, syncService.ts, importService.ts. Create proper error type definitions and use discriminated unions for consistent error handling.
close_reason: Created src/types/errors.ts with proper error type hierarchy (AppError, AuthError, ValidationError, NotFoundError, NetworkError, JobError). Updated routes and dispatcharrClient to use error: unknown with type guards.

title: Make debug logging conditional on environment
description: Multiple DEBUG log entries always emitted in exportService.ts, importService.ts (20+ debug logs for channel logo assignments). Should be conditional based on DEBUG or LOG_LEVEL environment variable.

title: Fix background job error propagation to UI
description: Background jobs in routes/export.ts, sync.ts, import.ts use .catch() that silently swallows errors. Job failures may not properly propagate to UI, leaving users unaware. Ensure all errors are properly surfaced.
close_reason: Updated export.ts, import.ts, sync.ts routes to properly capture background job errors and call jobManager.failJob() with formatted error messages so UI can display failures.

title: Generate OpenAPI spec from code
description: API endpoints documented in README but no OpenAPI/Swagger spec. swagger (1).json exists but appears outdated. Generate and maintain OpenAPI spec from code for API consumers.

title: Add Dependabot for automated dependency updates
description: No automated dependency update mechanism. Vulnerable to known security issues in dependencies. Add GitHub Dependabot or Renovate configuration.

title: Add external storage export support (S3, SMB, NAS)
description: Roadmap feature: Allow backup export to external storage like S3, SMB shares, or NAS. Currently users need local storage for backups. Would enable cloud backup strategies.

title: Implement logo sync between instances
description: Logo sync between instances is documented as not supported in README. Only backup/restore works for logos. Implement logo sync feature with proper ID mapping for sync operations.

title: Implement input validation with Zod for all API routes
description: Currently no standardized input validation. Routes do inline checks like if (\!request.source). Implement Zod schema validation for all route inputs to prevent invalid data reaching service layers. High security/reliability impact.
close_reason: Implemented Zod validation schemas for all API routes

title: Implement job data cleanup/archiving strategy
description: All jobs and logs loaded into memory at startup in jobManager.ts. Memory grows unbounded. Implement cleanup/archiving for jobs older than 30 days.

title: Enable TypeScript strict mode incrementally
description: tsconfig.json has strict: false and noImplicitAny disabled. Allows unsafe type coercion throughout codebase. Enable strict mode and fix type errors incrementally for better type safety.
close_reason: Enabled TypeScript strict mode incrementally (Phase 1): strictFunctionTypes, strictBindCallApply, noImplicitThis, alwaysStrict. Full strict mode requires adding API response types.

title: Add backup file encryption at rest
description: Roadmap feature: Encrypt backup files at rest for security. Important for users storing backups on shared or cloud storage.
close_reason: Added encryptBuffer/decryptBuffer for backup file encryption
